name: Unlock Addons for Elementor
author: Masud Hasan

sections.description:
Unlock Addons for Elementor is a powerful, lightweight WordPress plugin that expands your Elementor toolkit with 18 high-performance widgets. These widgets are fully customizable and work seamlessly with Elementor Free.

Whether you’re showcasing products, highlighting a team, capturing leads, or visualizing data, Unlock Addons gives you complete design control — without writing code.

Key benefits:
– Compatible with Elementor Free
– 18 flexible, fast-loading widgets
– Fully responsive and SEO-friendly
– Built using clean, WordPress-compliant code
– No bloat, no unnecessary dependencies

Perfect for agencies, designers, developers, and marketers who want to build modern, performant websites with fewer plugins.

Introduction Video

Watch the plugin overview on YouTube:

From Your WordPress Dashboard

  1. Navigate to Plugins → Add New
  2. Search for “Unlock Addons for Elementor“
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP from https://wordpress.org/plugins/unlock-addons-for-elementor
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  3. Upload the ZIP and click Install Now
  4. Click Activate Plugin

Getting Started

  1. Open any page in the Elementor editor
  2. Locate the Unlock Addons section in the widget panel
  3. Drag and drop any widget onto your canvas
  4. Use Elementor’s built-in controls to style and customize

No code required. Just design and publish.

Features & Widgets

Unlock Addons includes 18 high-performance widgets:

  1. Email Capture – Create attractive opt-in forms
  2. Blog Grid – Display blog posts in flexible grids
  3. Progress Bar – Add animated visual indicators
  4. Text Generator – Insert placeholder or AI-powered text
  5. Image Hotspot – Highlight areas with tooltips or links
  6. Team – Showcase team members with style
  7. Popup Anywhere – Trigger popups using buttons or sections
  8. Dynamic Chart – Create animated bar, line, or pie charts
  9. Google Sheet – Display live Google Sheet data
  10. Timeline – Build project or history timelines
  11. Product Grid – Showcase WooCommerce products
  12. Product Carousel – Add product sliders and carousels
  13. Dynamic Table – Show sortable, styled tables
  14. Showcase Slider – Highlight testimonials, portfolios
  15. Cookie Consent – Add GDPR-compliant cookie banners
  16. Customer Review – Display styled testimonials with ratings
  17. Price Menu – Show menus or services with pricing
  18. Circle Menu – Add expandable radial navigation

All widgets support full customization via Elementor’s layout, style, and advanced panels.

Optimization & SEO

Built with performance in mind:
– Loads only the widget assets you use
– Minified CSS/JS for faster loading
– SEO-friendly markup
– Compatible with all major themes
– Regular security and performance audits

Support

For documentation and support, visit:
https://unlockaddons.com/support

We provide:
– Detailed guides and FAQs
– Video walkthroughs
– Ticket-based support system

Credits

Developed by WordPress Realizer
Official Website: https://unlockaddons.com
Creative Support by WordPress Realizer
License: GPLv2 or later
License URI: https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-2.0.html
sections.faq:
Do I need Elementor Pro?

No. All widgets work with Elementor Free.

Will this slow down my site?

No. Only used widget assets are loaded.

Is there a premium version?

Not at this time. All features are free.

Does it work with all themes?

Yes. It’s designed to work with any Elementor-compatible theme.

How often is the plugin updated?

We release regular updates to improve performance, add features, and maintain compatibility with the latest WordPress and Elementor versions.
